title: L402: Lightning HTTP 402 Protocol — Builder's Guide
quote: L402 ... combines macaroons (cryptographic bearer credentials) with Lightning Network micropayments. The recommended token format is macaroons, which unlike cookies, can be verified using only a root key and basic cryptography.

title: LSAT: Authentication and Payments for the Lightning-Native Web
quote: LSAT: Authentication and Payments for the Lightning-Native Web (original Lightning Labs post; LSAT was later renamed L402 after the HTTP status code it activates; cf. s11 dating it to March 2020).

title: lightninglabs/L402 — Pay for APIs with Lightning. HTTP 402, realized.
quote: The L402 protocol repurposes the HTTP 402 Payment Required error code with the necessary authentication headers required to bind a request's validity to the payment of an LN invoice.

title: lightninglabs/aperture — L402 (Lightning HTTP 402) Reverse Proxy
quote: Aperture is an implementation of the L402 standard and is a reverse proxy that will forward a request with a valid L402 to their relevant API endpoint, while issuing macaroons and Lightning Network invoices to new users.

title: Fewsats/awesome-L402 — curated list of L402 projects
quote: Aperture: HTTP 402 reverse proxy ... Boltwall: Bitcoin Lightning paywall and authentication using L402s. ... Fewsats/l402-python: L402 client and server library for python projects. ... LangChainBitcoin: AI tools for giving LangChain agents access to Bitcoin and the ability to traverse L402 APIs.

title: Why L402 Is the Internet-Native Payments Protocol for Agents
quote: L402 verification is a local computation. The cryptographic artifact is the proof. There is no intermediary to ask, and no one who can fail to confirm. [Lightning Loop uses L402 via Aperture; the protocol operates exclusively on Bitcoin's Lightning Network.]

title: x402 vs L402: Stablecoins vs Lightning for APIs
quote: It settles payments in Bitcoin over the Lightning Network using macaroons — cryptographic tokens that make verification stateless. ... [x402] settles in USDC stablecoins on EVM chains, primarily Base and Solana. ... L402: payment settles in milliseconds ... Base completes in 1–3 seconds. Solana under a second.

title: Fewsats/L402-python — Payments for AI agents using L402
quote: L402 offers include amount, currency (e.g. 'USD'), description, offer_id, payment_methods (array), type. Example payment_methods: ['onchain']; pay via client.pay(response_json) which automatically uses the configured payment provider (e.g. Coinbase CDP wallet, chain 'base-sepolia', asset 'usdc').

title: Sherlock (Fewsats) — core payment flow
quote: payment_methods: ['credit_card', 'lightning'] ... Credit Card returns a Stripe checkout URL; Lightning provides a Lightning invoice. Pricing is in USD cents (e.g. 1105 = $11.05). The X402 purchase flow uses USDC on Base via Coinbase CDP as a separate mechanism.

title: Agent Payment Protocols — neutral landscape analysis
quote: L402 (originally LSAT) is the elder of the three, dating to a Lightning Labs post in March 2020 ... primarily inside Lightning Labs' own products. Where x402 and MPP authorize a single payment per request (sessions excepted), L402 issues a macaroon—a bearer token tied to a Lightning payment hash—that can be presented on subsequent requests until its caveats expire.

title: blip-0026: L402 — Lightning HTTP 402 Protocol
quote: The L402 protocol presents a standardized way of adding LN micropayments to any existing HTTP-REST or gRPC API. [The spec references BOLT 11 invoices and requires preimage-based proof of payment; it is Lightning-native and does not provide for alternative payment methods.]

title: Tierion/boltwall — Lightning paywall and authentication using L402
quote: Bitcoin Lightning paywall and authentication using LSATs. Built with LND, Nodejs, and Typescript. A server implementing Boltwall can dictate how long authorization is valid for based off a payment or restrict access to the originating IP.

title: Tierion/lsat-js — JS library for working with L402/LSAT
quote: A javascript library for working with LSATs (Lightning Service Authentication Tokens) [L402].
